cards.front: How do you write a [[kw:vertical translation]] of $f(x)$?
cards.back: $$g(x) = f(x) + k$$ If $k > 0$, the graph shifts [[imp:up]]. If $k < 0$, it shifts [[imp:down]]. This adds $k$ to each output value.

cards.front: How do you write a [[kw:horizontal translation]] of $f(x)$?
cards.back: $$g(x) = f(x - h)$$ If $h > 0$, the graph shifts [[imp:right]]. If $h < 0$ (e.g., $x + 3$), it shifts [[imp:left]]. The sign inside is opposite the direction!

cards.front: Write the function that translates $f(x) = 2x + 1$ three units down.
Write the function that translates $f(x) = 2x + 1$ two units left.

cards.back: A [[imp:reflection in the x‑axis]]. Multiply the entire output by $-1$. Each $y$-coordinate becomes its opposite.
A [[imp:reflection in the y‑axis]]. Replace $x$ with $-x$ inside the function. Each $x$-coordinate becomes its opposite.
$g(x) = -|x + 3| - 1$. Multiply the whole function by $-1$ and distribute: $g(x) = -(|x + 3| + 1) = -|x + 3| - 1$.

cards.front: Why does $f(x) = |x|$ look the same after a reflection in the y‑axis?
cards.back: Because $|-x| = |x|$, so $f(-x) = f(x)$. The absolute value function is [[imp:even]], meaning it is symmetric about the y‑axis.
$g(x) = a \cdot f(x)$ with $|a| > 1$. Each output value is multiplied by $a$, pulling points away from the x‑axis. The graph becomes [[imp:narrower]] (or taller).
$g(x) = a \cdot f(x)$ with $0 < |a| < 1$. Each output value is multiplied by a fraction, pushing points toward the x‑axis. The graph becomes [[imp:wider]] (or shorter).
$g(x) = f(bx)$ with $|b| > 1$. The graph compresses toward the y‑axis by a factor of $1/|b|$. The graph becomes [[imp:narrower]] horizontally.
$g(x) = f(bx)$ with $0 < |b| < 1$. The graph stretches away from the y‑axis by a factor of $1/|b|$. The graph becomes [[imp:wider]] horizontally.

cards.front: Write a function that vertically stretches $f(x) = |x - 3| - 5$ by a factor of 2.
cards.back: $h(x) = 2|x - 3| - 10$. Multiply the whole function by 2 and distribute: $h(x) = 2(|x - 3| - 5) = 2|x - 3| - 10$.

cards.front: Write a function that horizontally shrinks $f(x) = |x - 3| - 5$ by a factor of $1/3$.
What is the general combined transformation form?
cards.back: $$g(x) = a \cdot f(b(x - h)) + k$$ $a$: vertical stretch/shrink and x‑axis reflection. $b$: horizontal stretch/shrink and y‑axis reflection. $h$: horizontal translation. $k$: vertical translation.

title: Transformations of Lin. and Abs. Functions
